description: Source code for the StreamingSessionActor class, an Akka actor managing a streaming session, including subscription handling, message processing, JWT validation, and session lifecycle management within the Eclipse Ditto gateway streaming component.

classes.name: StreamingSessionActor
classes.description: Actor managing a single streaming session, handling subscriptions, message flow, JWT validation, and session lifecycle.

classes.name: WithStreamingType
classes.description: Abstract class representing messages related to specific streaming types.

classes.name: ConfirmSubscription
classes.description: Message indicating a subscription confirmation for a streaming type.

classes.name: ConfirmUnsubscription
classes.description: Message indicating an unsubscription confirmation for a streaming type.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Factory method to create Props configuration for StreamingSessionActor.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Initial setup, including watching publisher completion and declaring acknowledgement labels.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Cleanup actions when actor stops, such as closing session and completing publisher.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling behavior by combining multiple behaviors.

methods.name: createIncomingSignalBehavior
methods.description: Handles incoming signals, acknowledgements, and search commands.

methods.name: createOutgoingSignalBehavior
methods.description: Handles outgoing signals, responses, and session-specific message publishing.

methods.name: createPubSubBehavior
methods.description: Handles start/stop streaming, subscription management, and related acknowledgements.

methods.name: createSelfTerminationBehavior
methods.description: Handles JWT refresh, session timeout, and termination signals.

methods.name: handleTerminated
methods.description: Handles termination of publisher or actor, performing cleanup.

methods.name: logUnknownMessage
methods.description: Logs any unrecognized messages received by the actor.

methods.name: addPreprocessors
methods.description: Adds preprocessing steps to message handling pipeline.

methods.name: hasUndeclaredAckLabel
methods.description: Checks if an acknowledgement label is declared.

methods.name: ackLabelNotDeclared
methods.description: Handles acknowledgement label declaration errors.

methods.name: getReturnAddress
methods.description: Determines the return address for signals based on response requirement.

methods.name: isSameOrigin
methods.description: Checks if a signal originates from the same connection.

methods.name: isAckLabelNotUnique
methods.description: Checks if an exception indicates a non-unique acknowledgement label.

methods.name: ackLabelDeclarationFailed
methods.description: Handles failure in declaring acknowledgement labels.

methods.name: terminateWebsocketStream
methods.description: Unsubscribes and stops the actor to terminate the session.

methods.name: startAckregatorAndForward
methods.description: Starts acknowledgement aggregator and forwards signals.

methods.name: forwardToCommandRouterAndReturnDone
methods.description: Forwards signals to command router and returns completion.

methods.name: doNothing
methods.description: Returns the input result unchanged.

methods.name: startAckForwarder
methods.description: Starts acknowledgement forwarder for signals with ThingId.

methods.name: publishResponseOrError
methods.description: Publishes command responses or errors to the event publisher.

methods.name: forwardAcknowledgementOrLiveCommandResponse
methods.description: Forwards command responses to appropriate actors or publisher.

methods.name: forwardSearchCommand
methods.description: Sends search commands to subscription manager.

methods.name: isSessionAllowedToReceiveSignal
methods.description: Checks if a session is authorized and namespace-matched to receive a signal.

methods.name: startSessionTimeout
methods.description: Schedules session expiration timeout.

methods.name: handleSessionTimeout
methods.description: Handles session expiration, signaling termination.

methods.name: cancelSessionTimeout
methods.description: Cancels scheduled session timeout.

methods.name: checkAuthorizationContextAndStartSessionTimer
methods.description: Checks authorization context and starts session timer or terminates session.

methods.name: matchesNamespaces
methods.description: Checks if a signal matches session's namespace filter.

methods.name: refreshWebSocketSession
methods.description: Validates JWT and updates session authorization context.

methods.name: declareAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Declares acknowledgement labels cluster-wide.

methods.name: determineStreamingType
methods.description: Determines streaming type based on signal content.

methods.name: namespaceFromId
methods.description: Extracts namespace from entity ID.

methods.name: parseCriteria
methods.description: Parses filter string into Criteria object.

methods.name: confirmSubscription
methods.description: Confirms subscription acknowledgment.

methods.name: confirmUnsubscription
methods.description: Confirms unsubscription acknowledgment.

methods.name: checkForAcksWithoutResponse
methods.description: Validates acknowledgment headers for compliance.
